1.w: [“] And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, my standing [is] for a strengthener and for a stronghold to him.

2.w: And now I declare to you the truth: Behold, yet three kings will be rising up in Persia; and the fourth will be rich, [with] greater riches than all. And according to his strength by his riches, he will rouse everyone against the kingdom of Javan.

3.w: And a mighty king will arise, and he will rule [with] great dominion, and he will do according to his will.

4.w: And according to his standing, his kingdom will be broken up and will be divided to the four winds of the heavens, not to his posterity, and not according to his dominion by which he ruled; for his kingdom will be uprooted, and unto others apart from these.

5.w: And the king of the south will become strong, and one from his princes and will gain strength even over him, and he will rule; a great dominion [is] his dominion.

6.w: And at the end of years they will be united. And the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement; she will not retain the strength of her arm, and neither will he stand, [nor] his arm. And she will be given up, and those who brought her, and the one who begat her, and the one who strengthened her in those times.

7.w: And one will arise from a branch of her roots in his place. And he will come with an army, and he will come into the fortress of the king of the north, and he will deal with them and he will prevail.

8.w: And even their gods, with their princes, with the vessels of their desiring, silver and gold, he will carry away into captivity to Egypt. And he will stand back [some] years from the king of the north,

9.w: and he will come into the kingdom of the king of the south, and he will return to his own land.

10.w: And his sons will stir up strife, and they will gather a multitude of great forces, and it will keep coming coming [continually], and will flow over and pass through, and it will return and carry the war as far as his fortress.

11.w: And the king of the south will be enraged, and he will go out and fight with him, with the king of the north; and he will raise up a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

12.w: And he has taken away the multitude, and his heart will be lifted up; and thousands he will cause to fall, and he will not prevail.

13.w: For the king of the north will return, and he will raise a multitude greater than the first; at the end of the times of years, he will come forcefully with a great army and with many supplies.

14.w: And in those times, many will rise up against the king of the south; and sons of violence among your people will exalt themselves to fulfill the vision, and they will fall.

15.w: And the king of the north will come, and he will build a siege mound, and he will capture a city of fortifications; and the forces of the south will not stand; even their best troops [will have] no strength to stand.

16.w: And the one coming against him will do according to his will, and no one will stand before his face; and he will stand in the land of glory, with destruction in his hand.

17.w: And he will set his face to enter with the strength of all his kingdom, and upright ones with him; and he will act, and the daughter of women he will give to him, to corrupt her, and she will not stand and she will not be for him.

18.w: And he will turn back his face to the coastlands, and he will capture many, and a prince will bring to an end the scorn unto him. Nevertheless his scorn he will cause to turn back to him.

19.w: And he will turn his face toward the fortress of his own land, and he will stumble and fall, and he will not be found.

20.w: And there will arise upon his station one making pass through a pressing [for] the splendor of the kingdom; and in a few days he will be broken, though not in anger and not in battle.

21.w: And will arise upon his station a despicable one, and they will not give upon him the splendor of royalty, and he will come in a time of ease and will seize the kingdom by flatteries.

22.w: And the arms of the flood will be swept away from before him, and they will be broken, and also the prince of the covenant.

23.w: And after they join with him, he will act with deceit, for he will come up and become strong with a small number of people.

24.w: In a time of ease, he will enter the richest provinces, and he will do what his fathers have not done, [nor] the fathers of his fathers: Plunder and spoils and riches he will disperse unto them. And against the fortifications he will devise his plans, and only for a time.

25.w: And he will rouse his power and his heart against the king of the south with a great army. And the king of the south will be stirred up to battle, even exceedingly with a great and mighty army, and he will not stand, for they will devise plans against him.

26.w: And those eating of of his choice portion will destroy him, and his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.

27.w: And the two, kings, their heart [is] on evil. At a common table they speak lies, and it will not prosper, for still the end [is] at the appointed time.

28.w: And he will return to his land with great riches, and his heart [will be] against the covenant of holiness; and he will act, and he will return to his own land.

29.w: At the appointed time he will return, and he will come into the south; and this last time will not be like the first.

30.w: For the ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will be disheartened, and he will return, being angered against the covenant of holiness. And he will act, and he will turn back, and he will pay attention to those forsaking the holy covenant.

31.w: And forces from him will stand, and they will profane the sanctuary [and] the fortress, and they will turn away the daily sacrifice, and they will set up the abomination of desolation.

32.w: And those acting wickedly toward the covenant he will corrupt by flatteries; and the people [who] know their God will remain strong, and will take action.

33.w: And those acting prudently among the people will bring understanding to many; and they will fall by sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by plunder, for days.

34.w: And in their falling, they will be helped with a little help. And many will be joined to them with flatteries,

35.w: and some of understanding will fall, in order to refine them and to purify, and to make [them] white, until the time of the end. For [it is] yet for the appointed time.

36.w: And the king will act according to his desires, and he will exalt and magnify himself over every god, and he will speak blasphemies against the God of gods. And he will prosper until the wrath is accomplished, for what is decreed will be done.

37.w: And to the God of his fathers he will not pay attention, or to for the one desired by women. And he will not pay attention to any god, for he will magnify himself above [them] all.

38.w: And he will show honor to a god of fortresses in their place, and he will show honor to a god that his fathers did not know, with gold, and with silver, and with precious stones, and with desirable [things].

39.w: And he will act against the fortifications of strongholds with a foreign god. On those who acknowledge him, he will increase glory and make [them] to rule over many; and the land he will divide at a price.

40.w: And at the time of the end, the king of the south will thrust against him, and the king of the North will storm against him with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he will come into the lands, and will flow over and pass through.

41.w: And he will come into the land of glory; and many will be overthrown, and these will escape from his hand: Edom, and Moab, and the first [part] of the sons of Ammon.

42.w: And he will stretch out his hand against the countries, and the land of Egypt will not be for an escape.

43.w: And he will rule over the treasures of gold and silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and Cushites [will be] in his steps.

44.w: And news will disturb him from the east and from the north, and he will go forth with great fury to destroy and to devote to destruction many.

45.w: And he will plant the tents of his palace between the seas, to the mountain of the beauty of holiness; and he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
